      "observations": [
        "Complete five-path historical diff read/reused. Landing removes obsolete security.external_protocol_requires_permission default, introduces mail.external_protocol_requires_permission=false, excludes http/https from prompting, changes generic principal origin to messenger.xhtml, and retains supplied options.principal even when no permission patch is needed. Redundant Enigmail loadExternalURL wrapper is removed; attachment fallbacks call openLinkExternally with addToHistory:false directly.",
        "Current openLinkExternally74–109 parses URI, optionally starts history insertion with caught rejection, computes prompt policy and passes principal to external protocol loadURI. Current policy additionally always prompts for file URIs, unlike the original predicate. With no prompt it clones supplied principal/adds scheme permission or creates messenger content principal; otherwise uses supplied principal unchanged or system fallback. Native service behavior beyond this boundary is not proved.",
        "Complete current test retained with original full test; selected current callback/setup reread: all four link targets run sequentially across content tabs, extension popup and3pane host, verify one expected ID/nonblank URL and close created surfaces. Tests use registered extension ext+test handler, not native handoff; dialog callback explicitly sets disabled=false and clicks accept, so delay, focus, positioning and accessible use remain untested.",
        "Current setup uses pushPrefEnv and awaited folder/message creation, distinct from original direct pref+cleanup registration. awaitBrowserLoaded checks browser/document loading readiness and caller-provided URL predicate. These are current harness contracts, not grounds to export production permission bypass or universal navigation guarantees.",
        "Full Bug1928826 comments0–5 and D227776 full timeline/all2 actual inlines read, including summary edits retained by collector.
